title: Finite order symplectic birational self-maps on Kummer-type manifolds
summary: A projective hyperkähler manifold of Kummer-type is said to be twisted modular if it is birational to the Albanese fiber of a moduli space of twisted sheaves on an abelian surface. We prove that, with the exception of certain cases of Picard rank 3, any projective Kummer-type manifold admitting a finite-order symplectic birational self-map that acts nontrivially on its second cohomology group is twisted modular.
